Package com.csse3200.game.components.loot

Class WeaponUpgradeEffect

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.loot.WeaponUpgradeEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConsumableEffect
public class WeaponUpgradeEffect extends Object implements ConsumableEffect
The Upgrade Stone's effect: upgrades the weapon the player is holding by one tier.

The upgrade itself (stats, projectile count, dagger turning into a sword) comes from WeaponUpgrader. This class only connects it to the inventory: it takes the held weapon out of its slot, puts the upgraded weapons back, and selects them so the player is holding them again.

One stone upgrades every weapon in the held stack, not just one: for example, 20 tier 1 daggers become 20 tier 2 swords, because a dagger turns into a sword on its first upgrade. WeaponUpgrader upgrades one weapon at a time, so each weapon in the stack is upgraded and added on its own.

Using the stone means pressing its slot key, which selects the stone's slot first. The weapon to upgrade is therefore the one the player last selected, which ConsumableUseComponent remembers.

Like a health potion at full health, the stone is kept (the effect returns false) when there is no weapon to upgrade or the weapon is already at its highest tier.
